prior_attempt: Attempt 1 used MemoryHigh=64M/MemoryMax=128M and a 45 s controller timeout. It reached 76 MiB and was throttled without an OOM result; only that exact unit was stopped. No Codex process was lost.
change: Raise the synthetic test's MemoryHigh to 120M while retaining MemoryMax=128M so the local cgroup OOM condition is reached promptly; extend the controller timeout to 90 s and always stop only this uniquely named unit if the timeout still occurs.
acceptance: The unit alone reports oom-kill, memory.events reports a local oom_kill, memory.oom.group is 1, and Codex plus the invoking process remain alive.
